_comment: Opt-in review, static shadow: an explicit static route shadowing a known catalog ID keeps the static unknown base with no go.review; the catalog row is not listed. REDs before impl: startup rejects metadata_source.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "glm-5.3-flash"
provider = "chatup"
model = "custom-upstream"

[catalog]
url = "{UPSTREAM}/catalog"
timeout = 5
refresh_seconds = 0
metadata_source = "opencode-go-v1"

[catalog.model_providers]
"glm-5.3-flash" = "chatup"
name: m4_catalog_capability_shadow_static_keeps_base
